For the parity characterizations, one checks from the definition that the alternating pattern t_i = (-1)^i gives peaks exactly at odd positions, and t_i = (-1)^(i-1) gives peaks exactly at even positions. Conversely, if the peak set is all odd positions or all even positions, each sign t_i is recovered from the relevant neighboring peak condition (or endpoint condition), yielding the same two alternating sign patterns.
